verdict.rationale: Secureframe publishes a full OpenAPI 3.0.0 definition ("Secureframe API"), but only embedded inside the rendered reference page at api.secureframe.com/docs. An AI-native user has to extract it from roughly 490KB of page source rather than download it as a file. The REST API reference has request/response schemas and a documented versioning policy, which help consumers rely on the spec. Missing for 10: a documented standalone raw-spec download URL (openapi.json/yaml), any independent or hands-on confirmation that the extracted spec is complete and usable, and versioned spec artifacts.
